title: Plan simple WHERE aggregate column scan
problem: Bare SUM/AVG aggregate queries with simple WHERE predicates still materialized rows even when only predicate and aggregate columns were required.
approach: Detect single-table SUM/AVG column aggregates with a simple column-vs-constant predicate.
Support comparison operators =, !=, >, <, >=, <= and commuted constant-vs-column forms.
Decode only predicate and aggregate argument columns during table scan.
Keep complex predicates, subqueries, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, LIMIT, joins, and expression aggregates on the generic path.
expected_impact: Improve simple filtered SUM/AVG analytics on wide rows.
risk_controls: No optimization for AND/OR, IN, BETWEEN, LIKE, subqueries, or column-vs-column predicates.
Integration test corrupts unused column bytes to prove the fast path only decodes needed columns.
